purpose: New owner-intent development cohort; frozen and challenge fixtures remain unchanged. Routing does not prove answer correctness.

questions.query: What does the owner want CyberSand and Workbench to become?
facts: Paint-and-play authoring system with accessible controls; integrate useful capabilities through Workbench.

questions.query: Should saving a settled canvas flatten everything and destroy the session Undo history?
facts: Save desired evolved layout without unexpected live Undo destruction.
Explicit two-byte material Flatten differs from ordinary Save and a full checkpoint.

questions.query: Must physical simulation be scientifically consistent even when authored effects feel better?
facts: Convincing over consistent; authored alternatives welcome.
Correctness checks and failed evidence retain scoped meanings.

questions.query: Does prepared declared destruction require automatic whole-building stability and storage-sized chunks?
facts: Prepared declaration exploratory; blast/cut rolling pieces desired.
Fracture pieces are not specified as storage chunks.

questions.query: Should persistent areas catch up with real offline time or game time, and can transitions pause briefly?
facts: Game time, occasional few-second transition acceptable, optional simulate ahead.

questions.query: Are Materials Lab comparison tabs and a separate Strata Theatre enough for Workbench authoring?
facts: Four-layer Strata should be available as a Workbench option.
